book_title: One Dad & His Dog: 21-Week Golden Retriever Puppy Training Guide for Busy Dads - Boost Mental Health, Master Potty Training & Family Bonding
author: James        Macdonald
book_description: If you've recently buckled to the family requests of getting a dog but are worried how it could affect your "already" fragile mental health keep reading...If you're a dad, who struggles with his mental health, firstly I'm really sorry to hear that and you're not alone. If you're a dad with an already busy family,who like me,recently agreed to get a dog then this book is going to be for you.Are you concerned this big bundle of fluff might mean you're woken up even earlier? Then your spidey senses are on the money, that said as this book will explain, this canine alarm clock may be the answer to your prayers.Are you anxious that all this extra work and financial responsibility might damage your mental health? This is a justified concern as suicide is the single biggest killer of men under 45 in the UK.If any of these do concerns resonate with you, don't worry; you're in safe, albeit slightly doggy smelling hands.James Macdonald is a happy and mostly calm dad of four (3 humans 1 dog)In One Dad & His Dog you'll Week-to-week explanations of what's happening for your puppy's development and your family, as it prepares to welcome this new member.How being a dad of a dog might significantly improve your mental healthHow to rescue a golden retriever puppy from halfway up the stairs you told it several times not to go upWhat you can expect to pay for a golden retriever puppy plus all the other expenses.How to keep your sense of humour during those very smelly & messy moments.How to keep your puppy safe and happy in your homeHow to safely introduce them to other dogsHow to potty train them and stop them ruining all your furnitureHow to keep calm when all hell is breaking looseHow to support them during their first night away from mumHow having a dog can make you a much fitter and happier version of yourselfHow having a dog can improve the family's dynamicWhat you need to do & say to ensure everyone's mental health remains intactRoad-tested survival tips for dads of dogs to ensure you don't put your foot in it,literally.If you're ready to start the journey from poo bag fiddling novice to a contender for dog dad of the year then scroll up and click "Buy Now With 1-Click".Show more
